name: What is the ADA standard for grab bar installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the ADA standard for grab bar installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) provides specific guidelines for grab bar installation in public accommodations and commercial facilities, which can also serve as a useful reference for residential installations. ADA standards specify mounting heights, lengths, diameter, and distance from walls. For example, grab bars must be able to withstand a force of 250 pounds. Adhering to these guidelines ensures the highest level of accessibility and safety for users. We are familiar with these standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADA standards for grab bars specify requirements for mounting height, length, diameter, and strength (250 lbs force) to ensure accessibility and safety.
